name: vlabcb
description: AI research assistant for NYU Stern's V-Lab risk platform: Groq Llama 3.3 70B behind a Vercel Edge proxy

paragraphs: A conversational assistant for V-Lab, NYU Stern's public platform for volatility, correlation and systemic-risk research. Ask about GARCH volatility, SRISK, liquidity, climate risk or COVOL in plain language, or start from a topic, country or analysis shortcut.

About this repo: this is the public demo of the assistant I built as a Graduate Assistant in the VRI Director's Office (Jan–Jun 2026). The production work behind it is written up in my portfolio: a multi-agent design chosen after benchmarking 6 LLM providers on a 40-point rubric, which I rebuilt once I caught it rewarding fluency over correctness, followed by log-driven routing fixes after launch.
features: Topic navigation: docs shortcuts for Volatility, Correlation, SRISK, Long-Run VaR, Liquidity, Fixed Income, Climate and COVOL, plus live-data links
Country & analysis pickers: country questions are enriched with live data from the REST Countries API; general topics can pull Wikipedia summaries
Quick-ask chips for common questions, a typing indicator, a stop button and markdown-rendered answers
Rolling context: the last 20 messages go to the model, with a dated system prompt scoped to V-Lab and VRI
VRI events panel with conferences and past themes
